resolution: Sum2 is the existing upper-bound and no-extra-parts predicate Fusion. Sum3 is OverlapFusion with overlap-profile equality only. Sum2 implies Sum3 by partial-order structure; the reverse is supplied under strong supplementation, never by definition. Formation always guards nonempty families. A Sum3 witness need not contain its selected members, as the four-object rival shows. No composition-as-identity or substantial unity is identified with either.
